title: 第1章 各世遭遇第2章 你我时空相遇
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
繁星四月的天，星星布满整个天空，繁星高照，微风不燥，夜里还有些雾；给夜色填上了朦胧美。
高楼大厦，楼顶上。长长的桌上摆满了各色的食物，还有一个八层的星空蛋糕，酒水各色各样。
一群人穿着礼服，西装。一个高雅好看的女子举起手里的红酒杯，红红的脸上嘴角笑起了一个好看的弧度，眼睛眯了起来像弯弯的月亮，有些醉醉的喊道:
“谢谢各位来到我的生日party，今晚我们要不醉不归……”
给大家介绍一下自己，她叫昔小苑，是今晚生日party的主角，今天是她的18岁生日，也是她最悲伤的日子。
一群人也跟着举起手里的酒杯起哄，各个喝的烂醉如泥，有些抵不过酒精熏陶便倒在了地上、沙发上、椅子上……
昔小苑踩着她那高跟鞋，走路踉踉跄跄的，她踩上沙发上，背靠着墙，墙外边下是灯火阑珊的马路，离地面很高，掉下去便无生存的希望。
昔小苑拿起酒杯一饮而尽，有些苦涩的笑了。
昔小苑有些伤感的看着天空上的星星，为什么要拒绝她，她真的有这么差劲吗?
昔小苑回想起三个小时前的画面，她对着她喜欢已久的男神表白了，他是全民偶像白音熙。
她拿着麦克风，对着众人说出她一直埋藏心底的爱，她喜欢了他很久，趁今天有些酒意壮壮胆子……
昔小苑拿个麦克风，一脸真诚的看着下边站着的白音熙，说道:“我喜欢你，可以…做我男朋友可以吗？”
她低着头有些害羞的不敢看白音熙，也怕他会拒绝她，内心又是激动，又是紧张害怕。
白音熙想了想，但是还是对着众人，说出很是冷漠的话，道:“不好意思，我有喜欢的人了。”
昔小苑抬起头，很是认真的说道:“谁?难道我就比不上她吗?我……喜欢了你那么久，难道你就没有感受到吗？”
冷音逸依旧是那没什么情绪的表情说道:“我们不适合，你很好，你适合比我更好的人。”
昔小苑内心难受的一批，第一次表白被拒绝成这样，还是当着众人的面直接拒绝了，感觉好丢脸，也好难过……
下边的三两个女生在看她笑话，还说着闲话：“看……还以为她多厉害，到头来还不是被拒绝了。”
“人家可是全民偶像呢～她一个有钱富二代又怎么样，还不是一样被拒绝了吗～哈哈哈……”
昔小苑眼眶渐渐湿润，她强忍着泪水不让它流下，但是眼泪还是从眼眶溢了出来。

昔小苑突然有些慌张，也不知道该说什么了，声音有些沙哑的说道：“你……就真的不喜欢我吗？我…我对你这么好，我天天早起给你送早餐，即使天气很冷……但是我还是忍着冷意起来给你做，爱心早餐……”
“在学校里，我每天等你放学回家，每一天看不到你……我就心里难受一整天，见到你……我…我…我就开心的跟个三岁小孩一样。”
“你每年过生日，我都准时到场，还给你准备生日蛋糕，还给你准备好一切……还有我知道你有个梦想就是当个偶像，你喜欢唱歌……我…我拖了很多关系……”
“最后你如愿以偿了，终于成为你一直喜欢做的事，你已经成为了全民偶像……我的爱一直都在，你也没有拒绝，现在……你跟我说你喜欢上别人了？？”
昔小苑眼泪哗啦啦的流着，她坚持这么久，现在就腹水东流了一样？？这让她怎么能接受这现实？！！
昔小苑忍不住的吼道：“你为什么要这样！！”
白音熙眉头紧皱，随后说出很是伤人的话，说道：“这不都是你自愿的吗？？”
昔小苑一听，自愿？？哈哈哈…忍不住的自嘲。
昔小苑笑的撕心裂肺。
白音熙说完，他便头也不回的走了。她站在原地，眼泪一直忍不住的往外流，她就这么的被拒绝了，而且还是以这么冷漠连一丝表情情绪都没有的方式。
好样的！她长这么大第一次被人拒绝的这么干净利落。
还追了这么多年，到头来就是这种结果。
昔小苑回忆完，她一脸的悲伤，拿起脖子上的淡紫色玉佩看了看；被拒绝就算了，至少有你陪着我，这玉佩是她奶奶送她的生日礼物，奶奶很早很早就离她而去了。
唯有这个玉佩留她念想。
昔小苑看手里的酒杯空了打算去拿一杯，可惜脚下不稳，脚裸一扭，昔小苑整个人往后仰去，整个人消失在原地。
昔小苑从高楼不慎坠落，脑子空白一片，整个人失重，那失重的感觉可真的是不好受，而且她十八岁年华就这么的结束了吗……
……………没有感情的分割线……………
古代。楼阁上有一男子风度翩翩穿着一身飘逸的淡蓝色衣裳，眉目如画，面如冠玉，眼眸犹如一片汪.洋大海，又像那夜里的星辰一样好看。
男子英姿勃发的站着；看着远处的建筑，随后便抬头仰望着星空，又像是在等待些什么事情来临一般……
男子名为沐梓丞，是个大神级别的武功高手。
content_en:
On a starry April day, the sky is full of stars, the stars are shining high, the breeze is not dry, and there is still some fog at night, filling the night with hazy beauty.
High-rise buildings, on the roof. The long table was filled with all kinds of food, as well as an eight-layer starry sky cake, and a variety of drinks.
A group of people were wearing dresses and suits. An elegant and beautiful woman raised the red wine glass in her hand, her red face smiled into a beautiful smile, her eyes narrowed like the crescent moon, and she shouted drunkenly:
"Thank you for coming to my birthday party. We won't go home until we get drunk tonight..."
Let me introduce myself to everyone. Her name is Xi Xiaoyuan and she is the protagonist of tonight’s birthday party. Today is her 18th birthday and it is also her saddest day.
A group of people also raised their wine glasses and made a fuss. Everyone was so drunk that some couldn't withstand the influence of alcohol and fell to the ground, sofas, chairs...
Xi Xiaoyuan walked staggeringly on her high heels. She stepped on the sofa and leaned her back against the wall. Outside the wall was a dimly lit road. It was very high from the ground. If she fell, there would be no hope of survival.
Xi Xiaoyuan picked up the wine glass and drank it all in one gulp, smiling bitterly.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at the stars in the sky with some sadness, why should she reject her? Is she really that bad?
Xi Xiaoyuan recalled the scene three hours ago. She confessed to the male god she had liked for a long time. He was the national idol Bai Yinxi.
She took the microphone and told everyone the love she had always buried in her heart. She had liked him for a long time, so she took advantage of the fact that she was drunk today to gain courage...
Xi Xiaoyuan took a microphone, looked at Bai Yinxi standing below with a sincere face, and said, "I like you, can... can you be my boyfriend?"
She lowered her head and was too shy to look at Bai Yinxi. She was also afraid that he would reject her. She was excited, nervous and afraid at the same time.
Bai Yinxi thought for a while, but still said very cold words to everyone, "I'm sorry, I have someone I like."
Xi Xiaoyuan raised her head and said seriously: "Who? Am I not as good as her? I... have liked you for so long, don't you feel it?"
Leng Yinyi still said with the emotionless expression: "We are not suitable, you are very good, you are suitable for someone better than me."
Xi Xiaoyuan felt uncomfortable in her heart. It was the first time she confessed her love and was rejected like this, but she refused directly in front of everyone. She felt so embarrassed and sad...
The three or two girls below were laughing at her and chatting: "Look... I thought she was so awesome, but she was rejected in the end."
"She is a national idol~ So what if she is a rich second generation? She was rejected in the same way~ Hahaha..."
Xi Xiaoyuan's eyes gradually became moist, and she resisted the tears from falling, but the tears still overflowed from her eyes.
Xi Xiaoyuan suddenly panicked and didn't know what to say. She said in a hoarse voice: "You... really don't like me? I... I am so good to you. I get up early every day to bring you breakfast. Even if the weather is very cold... But I still bear the coldness and get up to make you a love breakfast..."
"In school, I wait for you to come home from school every day. Every day I don't see you... I feel uncomfortable all day long. When I see you... I... I... I am as happy as a three-year-old child."
"Every year you celebrate your birthday, I arrive on time, prepare a birthday cake for you, and prepare everything for you... Also, I know that you have a dream to be an idol, and you like to sing... I... I have delayed a lot of relationships..."
"In the end, you got what you wanted. It finally became what you always liked to do. You have become a national idol... My love has always been there, and you have not refused. Now... you told me that you have fallen in love with someone else??"
Xi Xiaoyuan's tears were streaming down her face, and she insistedIt's been going on for so long, and now it's like the water has drained out of your belly? ? How could she accept this reality? ! !
Xi Xiaoyuan couldn't help but yelled: "Why are you doing this!!"
Bai Yinxi frowned, and then said very hurtful words, "Isn't this all of your own free will?"
When Xi Xiaoyuan heard this, she volunteered? ? Hahaha... I couldn't help but laugh at myself.
Xi Xiaoyuan laughed heartbreakingly.
After Bai Yinxi finished speaking, he left without looking back. She stood there, tears streaming down her face uncontrollably. She was rejected just like that, and in such a cold and indifferent way without even a trace of emotion.
Well done! It was the first time in her life that she was rejected so neatly.
After pursuing it for so many years, this is the result in the end.
After Xi Xiaoyuan recalled, she had a sad look on her face and picked up the lavender jade pendant around her neck and looked at it; Forget it if I was rejected, at least you are with me. This jade pendant was a birthday gift from her grandma, who left her very early.
Only this jade pendant left her to think about it.
Xi Xiaoyuan saw that the wine glass in his hand was empty and planned to get a glass. Unfortunately, his feet were unsteady and his ankle twisted. Xi Xiaoyuan leaned back and disappeared from the spot.
Xi Xiaoyuan accidentally fell from a high building, her mind went blank, and her whole body became weightless. The feeling of weightlessness was really uncomfortable, and her eighteen years were over like this...
…………There is no emotional dividing line…………
ancient times. There is a man on the pavilion who is elegant and elegant, wearing elegant light blue clothes. His eyebrows are picturesque, his face is like a crown of jade, his eyes are like a vast ocean, and he is as beautiful as the stars in the night.
The man stood tall and handsome; looking at the buildings in the distance, then he looked up at the starry sky, as if he was waiting for something to happen...
The man's name is Mu Zicheng, and he is a martial arts master at the level of a great god.
